edge_case_tests.description: Verify that when EscalationLadder reaches ADVANCED with an unavailable preserved variant, it passes the variant unchanged to resolve_model, which handles the fallback and emits the DEBUG log — EscalationLadder does not log.
preconditions: Python logging capture enabled at DEBUG level
edge_case_tests.input: EscalationLadder at top (ADVANCED) with starting_variant='fast' (unavailable for ADVANCED)
edge_case_tests.expected: resolve_model called with variant='fast'; fallback DEBUG log emitted by resolve_model, not EscalationLadder
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode:
with capture_logs(level='DEBUG') as logs:
    with mock(resolve_model, wraps=resolve_model) as mocked_rm:
        ladder = EscalationLadder(starting_tier='ADVANCED', starting_variant='fast')
        result = ladder.resolve_current_model()
        assert mocked_rm.call_args[1]['variant'] == 'fast'
# All DEBUG logs come from resolve_model module path
assert all('escalation' not in log.name for log in logs if log.levelno == logging.DEBUG)
